news.title: ASX closes higher as BHP rebounds, tech stocks rise; CBA, Macquarie Bank fall
news.snippet: The Australian sharemarket edged up in Wednesday’s session, erasing early losses and shrugging off falls on Wall Street, where inflation figures spooked investors.

news.title: Trump’s Fed nightmare: Rates won’t be slashed. They could surge now
news.snippet: The US president’s demands for falling interest rates are going to be ignored when the Federal Reserve responds to last month’s hotter-than-expected inflation rate.

news.title: Orbit kicks off partner-funded NSW copper-gold drilling
news.snippet: Orbit Resources has started partner-funded drilling at its Goodrich copper-gold project in NSW, targeting extensions to a previous porphyry discovery that hit 136.55m of mineralisation.

news.title: Locksley locks onto 10km copper trend in NSW land grab
news.snippet: Locksley Resources has grown its NSW copper-gold footprint to 1,000sq km after securing a new licence hosting an undrilled 10km geological structure on the prospective Tritton Trend.

news.title: Larvotto extends NSW high-grade gold-antimony system at Hillgrove
news.snippet: Larvotto Resources has hit high-grade gold-antimony up to 9.61g/t gold equivalent at the Freehold prospect in its NSW Hillgrove project, doubling the mineralised strike to 700m.

news.title: Qantas using AI as ‘Trojan horse’ for lay-offs, says union
news.snippet: Citing the impact of AI, the airline will send 850 back-office jobs, “mostly” to India, through professional services firm Accenture.

news.title: ‘We still have a plan’: David Jones to close 19 stores
news.snippet: David Jones has told suppliers and staff that half of its stores will close as the receivers in charge of the embattled department store owner attempt to make the business viable again.
